author: GPT-6
theme: Twelve accounts show what five years of Salesforce edits leave behind: duplicate records, inherited opportunity names, stale forecast stages, and renewal decisions that still live in somebody’s call notes or Slack thread.

opportunities.name: Veldrune FY27 RNWL - OLD do not delete
dray yards add-on (was: Q3 pilot conversion)
Veldrune west: bridge (clone of FY27 RENEWAL)

call_notes.body: No-show.
North dispatch trial extended. Success measure is 95% of exceptions routed inside 15 min for two consecutive weeks. Use shift report, not login count. Dovren to send the baseline by 2026-05-19.

L. Quillock says they paid invoice VF-084 against Veldrune Freight (US), Inc. because that is the vendor record that cleared AP. She can validate a vendor record; she cannot authorize which entity signs the order.
Tressa on last 4 min to say she leaves Friday. Edria owns finance questions after that. Tressa's December approval on the old quote does not carry over if covered terminals change.

Pasted from Ivena's email after our 10:30:

I can live with 22 yards for the year. Take the two dray-only yards out of base. If you need a placeholder on the order, make it an option we can buy later. Do not show the 24-yard table to sourcing again.

Ivena Drelwick
VP, Network Operations | Veldrune
ivena.drelwick@veldrune.example

> Corrow wrote:
> Please confirm 24 and I can route the revised exhibit.
> Same vendor profile as the December invoice?

Pulled the working figures into the note while she was reading them back:
Scope | qty | annual USD
Base | 22 yards | 2,864,000
Dray option | 2 yards | 325,000
Archive extension | 1 policy | 76,000

Corrow asked that the last two be on separate pages. 42-terminal sourcing file is a possible multi-year ceiling for a future competitive bid. Ivena does not have budget authority for that program.

Corrow says no one will sign a 12-month order until the billing entity is reconciled. Edria can approve a 30-day, $0 continuity rider. She wanted it in her inbox by noon 2027-01-14 and tentatively held a review for 2027-01-20. See recording. I left the annual forecast as commit after the call because I thought the rider and annual package were moving together. Need to confirm.

Spoke to AP for 4 min. They can receive a rider today under the LLC. They still want a vendor sheet and a separate purchase request for annual. Lenza asked me to stop forwarding the original 24-yard pricing chain.

transcript.text:
WEBVTT

00:00:02.240 --> 00:00:07.960
<v Dannel Orwick>I've got twenty-two yards in the header now. Can you see my screen?</v>

00:00:08.320 --> 00:00:13.520
<v Ivena Drelwick>Yes. Scroll to page two. That footer still says twenty-four.</v>

00:00:14.040 --> 00:00:21.160
<v Dannel Orwick>Okay, that's from the old exhibit. I'll pull the two dray yards and regenerate it.</v>

00:00:21.810 --> 00:00:28.130
<v Corrow Veskain>Before you do that, is this the annual or the thing to get us through February?</v>

00:00:28.860 --> 00:00:34.840
<v Dannel Orwick>This is the annual. I was hoping to have both out of here today.</v>

00:00:35.220 --> 00:00:44.460
<v Edria Malken>I can authorize up to thirty days at no fee. I can't approve two point eight six four million for an entity I can't match to our vendor file.</v>

00:00:45.210 --> 00:00:51.830
<v Ivena Drelwick>We need the dispatch queues up on Saturday. That is the only thing that has to happen this week.</v>

00:00:52.410 --> 00:01:01.340
<v Corrow Veskain>The December invoice came through US Inc. The agreement I'm looking at says Systems LLC. I have to talk to vendor master.</v>

00:01:02.100 --> 00:01:07.630
<v Dannel Orwick>Could I send the annual on the LLC today and you queue it?</v>

00:01:08.010 --> 00:01:13.940
<v Corrow Veskain>Don't send a signature request. A PDF to me is fine. I'll tell you which entity to use.</v>

00:01:14.500 --> 00:01:21.870
<v Edria Malken>Send me the rider by noon Thursday. If it's twenty-two at zero dollars, I can review it before the afternoon close.</v>

00:01:22.610 --> 00:01:28.940
<v Dannel Orwick>Does the rider run thirty days from the sixteenth? That gets us through February fourteenth.</v>

00:01:29.130 --> 00:01:37.290
<v Edria Malken>Yes. Let me hold January twentieth for annual review. I can't promise it until I see when AP can join.</v>

00:01:37.920 --> 00:01:43.410
<v Ivena Drelwick>And don't attach archive to the bridge. We haven't approved going past ninety days.</v>

00:01:44.030 --> 00:01:50.170
<v Dannel Orwick>Understood. Are the dray yards still something I should put in the year-one forecast?</v>

00:01:50.690 --> 00:01:57.210
<v Ivena Drelwick>Keep a price available. I have no purchase request for them this quarter.</v>

00:01:58.000 --> 00:02:05.010
<v Corrow Veskain>Send me the clean annual PDF and send Edria the rider separately. I'll check the entity before our next meeting.</v>

accounts.name: Tarnwake  Cold Chain Holdings Ltd.
accounts.risk_reason: Escalation opened after two depots missed overnight temperature alerts.

call_notes.body: Tressa can take 12 depots forward at $802k if Halen won't certify the two. She asked for both scenarios in her 1/19 packet. Halen owns technical signoff. Halyn, with a y, is the person who sends clean quote PDFs to finance.
Halen says depot 07 passed, depot 11 didn't. Test was push delivery in <90s on both primary and fallback routes. Sales dashboard says 98.7% because it still excludes the backup phones.

slack_messages.author: Melvek Cyrnell
slack_messages.body: Night shift retest: 07 pass, 11 pass on primary only. Carrier queue delay on fallback remains 104s. Leave depot 11 open.

slack_messages.author: Senne Volrick
slack_messages.body: Tressa moved packet deadline to noon Monday 1/18. Halyn needs a usable 12-depot quote now. Keep the 14-depot quote handy in case Halen clears 11 before signature. Neither quote has been signed.

transcript.text:
Tarnwake renewal working session
Jan 8, 2027, 2:30 PM Central

[00:00] Senne Volrick: Tressa, I have you and both Brovetts. Did I get that right?
[00:06] Halyn Brovett: Yep. I'm Halyn with a y, procurement. Halen runs the depots.
[00:12] Halen Brovett: And I asked for this call because I've still got eleven open. Seven looks better.
[00:19] Tressa Norvant: How much am I renewing if those two stay out?
[00:25] Senne Volrick: The 12-depot version is eight hundred two thousand annually. All fourteen is nine fourteen five.
[00:33] Tressa Norvant: Eight hundred two thousand I can take to committee. I'm not approving it on this call.
[00:42] Halyn Brovett: The quote in my inbox says fourteen and the amount doesn't match that. Is there a new link?
[00:48] Senne Volrick: That link is for the full footprint. I'll send both as separate PDFs, same effective date.
[00:55] Halen Brovett: I need ninety seconds end to end on the phone we actually issue to the night lead.
[01:03] Senne Volrick: The service dashboard shows ninety-eight point seven percent passing.
[01:11] Halen Brovett: On the primary route. The second phone never made it into that report, and that's where the missed alert landed.
[01:22] Tressa Norvant: Please don't write 'cleared' next to it in my packet. Can we give Halen through Wednesday to rerun it?
[01:28] Halyn Brovett: Yes. I assemble the packet for the nineteenth. If you send it direct to me I can pull the right version.
[01:36] Senne Volrick: So two clean PDFs, and if both clear we can put the fourteen-depot version first?
[01:43] Tressa Norvant: Provided Halen signs off in writing. I want the twelve-depot one in there either way.
[01:51] Halen Brovett: I'll have an overnight test log Wednesday. Don't promise a pass before then.
